module.title: Full-f Gyrokinetic DG Solvers
entrypoints: gyrokinetic/luareg/ (Lua gyrokinetic inputs through the gkeyll executable)
module.expensive_path: Full-f gyrokinetic phase-space DG updates, collision/source operators, moments, field solves, and geometry evaluation over tokamak or mirror coordinates; production cases combine high-dimensional kernels with global reductions and elliptic solves.
module.rationale: Gyrokinetics uses a reduced physical model, specialized geometry, field equations, boundary conditions, and verification cases that are scientifically distinct from full Vlasov kinetics.
excluded: Full Vlasov-Maxwell/Vlasov-Poisson evolution belongs to the Vlasov module.
PKPM's perpendicular-moment closure is treated as its own model.
hazards: Some cases depend on optional ADAS data or machine-specific linear-algebra/GPU facilities.
Large realistic geometries and grids are unsuitable as bounded benchmark fixtures without reduction.
